title: Agent permissions on one computer (agents.json in the app data folder)
description: What agents may do (AGT-03, D-145). Missing or invalid: nothing is allowed. Deleting, visibility changes, and sharing are never available to agents, so they have no setting.

connect.description: Agents can connect. Off: the server refuses to start

readPublic.description: Read public notes (notes/). On by default, once agents can connect

edit.description: Create and edit notes. Editing a note also needs reading its root

createPublic.description: Create public notes; otherwise new notes are private

folders.description: Limit to folders: "all", or workspace-relative folders under notes/ or private/notes/. An empty list allows nothing
